title: fix(pm): mkdtempSync completeness fails tests and tooling, reports shipped package source
body:
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_ Fixes #35611 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Ruling-ref: 7075362923 ## 维护者速读 - 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;车队门禁的「临时目录扫描」不再因为发布代码里由用户运行时决定位置的暂存目录而判红,测试和仓库脚本照旧判红。 - 为什么做:执行你选的「扫描只管仓内运行的代码」裁决,解开技能安装「失败可回滚」修复被撤回的卡点。 - 出错会怎样:最坏是发布代码里一个真会落进仓库的暂存目录只被报告、不被拦下;今天这一类为零,撤回本改动即可恢复原判法。 - 要你做什么:本改动碰到门禁本身,需要你批准后才能合入。 ## What changes The `mkdtempSync` completeness rule of the directory-creating sweep in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` now judges an UNRESOLVED site by its **file population**, as ruling record 7075362923 orders. The maintainer's choice, verbatim: 「扫描只管仓内运行的代码」; the option's stated consequence, verbatim: 「完整性规则只管测试与仓库脚本,发布代码同类调用只报告不判红;门禁小幅收窄,技能安装修复原样重新合入。」 - **Test files and repo tooling: still FAIL** on an unresolved `mkdtempSync` base, exactly as before. - **Shipped package source: REPORTED, not failed.** The live case names each such site on its own line and stays green. - **The boundary is one predicate, `isShippedPackageSource(rel, members)`:** a non-test source under the own `src/` of a workspace member whose manifest is not `private: true` (members come from `workspacePackages`' `{dir, manifest}` pairs; a private member, or one whose manifest does not parse, stays on the failing side). "Non-test" reuses the runner-env gate's `isProductSource` (a test by file name or by directory, `.d.ts` excluded). That is the stricter of the tree's test predicates, so a helper under `src/__tests__/` is still held. "Workspace package" means a workspace-enumerator member that holds a published (non-`private`) manifest. The predicate keeps no list of its own. The filter is the file, never "in-tree", because an unresolved site is exactly the one whose location is unknown. It is also not `isTestFilePath` alone, which would drop the 344 tooling sites. - `mkdtempCompleteness(unresolved, { members })` (default: `workspacePackages(ROOT)`) returns `{ failing, reported }`. The live slow case and the new fast pins call the same function. - The in-tree/uncovered rule (`exposedScratchDirs`) is unchanged for every population. No new gate, derivation row, ratchet or constant (`instrument-discipline.md`). - Header: the stale "359 sites, 4 in the tree" is replaced with a dated reading taken through the scan's own exports, plus the boundary in one sentence. - Riders, per the ruling record's seat reading: the #30467 site stays as landed. Spellings 7 and 8 stay as they are for test fixtures, and this diff does not touch either. After this merges, #35079's lane re-lands the #35495 staged swap as written. This PR does not re-land it. Files to read first (risk order): 1. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `isShippedPackageSource` / `mkdtempCompleteness` (just above `isTrackedIgnoreSource`). This is the narrowing hunk: the predicate decides which unresolved sites stop failing. 2. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, the live case "no mkdtempSync site in a test file or repo tooling takes a base the scan cannot read" (slow section). 3. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, the new fast-tier block "Which UNRESOLVED mkdtempSync site fails completeness". Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test --fast 2>&1 | grep -A11 "REPORTED, not failed"` should print twelve `✓` lines: the shipped arm reported, plus the private-member, non-own-`src/`, test, `__tests__` and tooling arms failing, each next to its control. ## Tests New fast-tier pins (the tier a pull request's lane runs), on the exact spelling that turned main red (`mkdtempSync(join(dir, SKILLS_STAGING_PREFIX))`): | Arm | Verdict | Control one step away | |:--|:--|:--| | `packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts` | reported, not failed | same file, `packages/cli` not a workspace package: FAILS; same package, outside `src/`: FAILS | | the same site in a `private: true` member's `src/` | FAILS | the published member: reported | | `packages/cli/scripts/src/staging.ts` (a `src/` that is not the member's own) | FAILS | the member's own `src/`: reported | | `…/skills-install-state.test.ts` (by name), `src/__tests__/…` (by directory) | FAILS | the test file on a `tmpdir()` base: in neither list | | `scripts/pm/stage-skills.mjs` (repo tooling) | FAILS | the tooling file on a `tmpdir()` base: in neither list | | unresolved `mkdirSync` | in neither list | (that half was never held to completeness) | | this tree's own workspace (default `members`) | shipped arm reported, tooling arm FAILS | n/a | Runs at `f7e942e8` (before the rework; this branch merged with `origin/main` `d8599c2c`). At the rework head `3ec2a452` the dev reran both tiers, exit 0: fast 2264 case(s) · slow 315 case(s), 2579 cases pass, including the 12 boundary pins (os-dev-report 7077315476).
Both tiers, the slow section that holds the live case included: node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test, exit 0 ```text ✓ a caller's-directory mkdtempSync base in shipped package source is REPORTED, not failed ✓ CONTROL: the same file in a directory that holds no workspace package still FAILS ✓ CONTROL: and in the package but outside its own src/ (one directory up), it still FAILS ✓ the same site in a test file FAILS — beside the shipped file, by name ✓ and in a test helper under src/__tests__/, by directory — the stricter test predicate holds it ✓ CONTROL: the test file with a base the scan CAN read (the system temp directory) is in neither list ✓ the same site in repo tooling FAILS — the tooling population is not dropped with the test predicate ✓ CONTROL: the tooling file with a base the scan CAN read is in neither list ✓ and an unresolved mkdirSync site is in neither list — that half was never held to completeness ✓ on this tree's own workspace, the shipped arm is REPORTED and the tooling arm FAILS ... ✓ the sweep really read this tree (3145 directory-creating site(s) across 23403 tracked source(s)) ✓ and it really found in-tree fixture roots (93), so the coverage case below judges something ✓ no mkdtempSync site in a test file or repo tooling takes a base the scan cannot read ... dispatch-gates self-test tiers: fast 2262 case(s) in 1009.1s · slow 315 case(s) in 1825.0s. ✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2577 cases pass. ```
Fast tier as CI runs it: pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates, exit 0 ```text ✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 2262 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred. check:pm-dispatch-gates: the battery (the fast tier) took 562.7s on this box. ```
## Acceptance notes - **The #35495 spelling passes the slow case now (scratch copy, not re-landed here).** I checked out a scratch worktree at this branch's head and applied #35495's merge diff (`578d3b1d66`: the skills-install-state source, its test, its changeset). I then ran the slow case's own logic on that tree through the scan's exports (`exposedScratchDirs` + `mkdtempCompleteness`). Result: origin/main's rule FAILS, `UNRESOLVED: packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts:246 (dir is not bound in this file)`; this branch's rule has failing 0 and reported 1 (the same site), so the case passes. Exposed: 0. - **Boundary reading, resolved by the seat (reading B, rework 3ec2a452).** The maintainer's words 「扫描只管仓内运行的代码」 and 「发布代码同类调用只报告不判红」: a `private: true` member (`examples/*`, `apps/docs`, QA harnesses, the eslint plugin…) is not published code, so its `src/` keeps failing. L2 7076625985 graded the literal-rider reading M1; L1-d had preferred the literal reading (7076590966) and accepted the seat's ruling. Pins: a private member's `src/` site FAILS with the published arm as control, and `packages/cli/scripts/src/staging.ts` FAILS as the control for "the member's own `src/`" (L2 S1). The header's measurement is dated by base tree `d8599c2c`: 1823 sites, 1465 test (47 in-tree), 344 other, 14 shipped (tmpdir), 0 unresolved. - **Ablation not run.** The diff is a repo script, and the dispatch contract does not ablate scripts. The fast pins carry their own controls, and each control flips the verdict. - The live case's title changed from "no mkdtempSync site in this tree…" to "no mkdtempSync site in a test file or repo tooling…". No other file names the old text (`git grep` 0 hits). ## Verification
Derived gate families: 63 derived, 62 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun (at f7e942e8) - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 families. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).` - 62 exit 0, including `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`, `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` (+ `--self-test`) and `node scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs` (+ `--self-test`). - NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:i18n-coverage`, exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the package `dist/` builds it lints against are not built in this worktree, and this diff touches no package). CI runs it. - `node scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs` first refused with `spawnSync node ETIMEDOUT` (load average 11 on a shared box, so no verdict). It was rerun at load 7.4 on the same head: exit 0. - `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/issue-35611-mkdtemp-shipped-report` → `VERDICT clean exit 0` before each push. - Body gate: `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --body` binds exactly one declaration, this card's, on the line under the header.
Tier H: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is a governed guard instrument, so this lands only on the maintainer's approval. `skip-changeset`: `scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
